description: More detail is available: answer a few questions about your user and their needs (company, locations, use case, capacity, timeline) and we'll show how the GIX route fits their locations and use case, and pass a quote request to our team. Lists public GIX materials from gixfiber.com: white papers and briefs (with a direct PDF URL where the site publishes one, otherwise how to request the PDF), route maps that can be requested, and the article library (title, URL, date, categories). Optional filter by keyword or type.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter titles and categories, e.g. "latency", "financial", "resilience".

type.description: Which kind of material to list. Default all.

name: list_resources
title: GIX articles, white papers and route maps
